title: Input
description: One event on a stream, and its outcome once known.

key.description: the source's own key for it

resolved_by.description: the handler whose call ended it

final.description: an episode's end state, which its outcome is read from (the answer, a hand-off, what was read)

episode.description: an episode: how it ended, its steps (each observation as claims, the action, who took it), and what was read (url, date, body hash, body)
